source_snapshot.items: Check NIC link status and link speed after reset-nic-linkstate
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; assumes reset then an unspecified readback.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: HIGH; requires OEM semantics, port mapping, one-shot reset, link oracle and recovery.

old_problem: The OEM command and argument `1` are undefined, the source omits the promised link-state/speed readback and expected values, and the command can drop its own only management path or mask failure through failover.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits a draft for standard BMC behavior but explicitly forbids guessed OEM parameters. Here command semantics, target mapping and readback oracle are the core operation; without vendor evidence and an independent path, execution and PASS/FAIL cannot be made safe.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2255 and 2256, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical record and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve literal `reset-nic-linkstate 1` plus link-status and speed coverage.
Require vendor definition of command/argument and physical/logical port, management/failover role and target firmware.
Require independent console, pre-state, one-shot approval, bounded outage/settle and port-specific admin/operational/speed/duplex/counter readback.
SSH recovery alone cannot prove target-port recovery because another interface may take over.
No BMC login, NIC reset, link flap, retry, configuration change or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: One-shot OEM BMC NIC link-state reset and port-specific recovery
test_case.purpose: Reset the exact vendor-defined BMC NIC selected by argument 1 once and prove that the intended port—not merely an alternate path—returns to its approved link state and speed.
required_package: Approved status/speed/duplex/counter readback and expected values
Independent console, outage/settle timeout and recovery
test_case.test_command: Gate closed. After vendor mapping and one-shot approval, capture port-specific pre-state from an independent path, invoke exactly `reset-nic-linkstate 1` once, timestamp outage, then collect the approved physical/operational link, speed/duplex, counters and reachability through settle timeout without retry.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped target alone performs the documented reset and returns within timeout to the approved operational state and negotiated speed/duplex without counter faults, unrelated-interface impact or lost management recovery.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative semantics/mapping, exact pre/post readback and bounded recovery. Command exit or generic SSH reachability cannot pass. Unknown target/semantics/readback keeps Pending; wrong port, mismatch or unrecovered access is FAIL.
safety_gate: Never reset an unknown or sole recovery interface.
Independent console and exact maintenance approval required.
One invocation only; no blind retry.
Stop on wrong target, prolonged outage, link flap, counter escalation or failover ambiguity.
expected_evidence: Literal command output plus outage/settle/recovery timeline
Unrelated-interface invariance, final reachability and verdict
test_case.recovery: If the target does not recover, preserve console/network/BMC evidence and use only the independent approved path to restore service; never repeat the reset automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The title's status/speed verification is still absent from Master steps and cannot be safely invented without the OEM readback contract.

blocked.reason: Vendor evidence could make the test conditionally executable; it is not intrinsically impossible.
